opening.argument: The substance is analysis of macroeconomic developments and their possible effect on crypto markets. The speaker says he will pull apart “the most important parts” and discusses how rising M2 may correlate with crypto prices, while offering a conditional outlook tied to possible interest-rate hikes. The Tangem wallet promotion is identifiable as a separate commercial element: viewers are directed to use the speaker’s link for a discount, and the description discloses that he may earn a commission. The accompanying disclosures state that no profits or outcomes are guaranteed and that crypto-assets involve substantial risk. Those facts do not establish deceptive conduct or a guaranteed-return promise.
